'''Cinda''' is a serving girl at the [[Stag and Lion]] in [[Baerlon]].

==Activities==
Cinda, and fellow serving girl [[Mari]], help Master [[Fitch]] serve dinner to [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Perrin Aybara]], [[Matrim Cauthon]], [[Thomdril Merrilin]], and [[Egwene al'Vere]].{{ref/book|1|14}}
